description: This file handles AJAX requests for resetting or restoring device settings, such as rebooting, resetting WiFi settings, or factory resetting the device. It also includes some functions for managing MAC filters and performs input validation and security checks.

methods.name: delMacFilterTable
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for specified access points and disables MAC filtering for them.

methods.name: delMacFilterTables
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for a set of predefined access points.
